purpose: Re-evaluate previously sealed neural controls under the frozen leave-one-chemical-out open-world protocol. Configurations are inherited from earlier grouped-development studies and are not selected using open-world baseline outcomes.

controls.training: triplet margin 0.2; cross-instrument positive preferred; same-instrument negative preferred; edge-filled shift and Gaussian-noise augmentation
controls.primary_score_rationale: The historical Siamese model is a metric learner; nearest-prototype distance is its native novelty score.

controls.epoch_rule: rounded median of 20 development-only global winner best epochs (57.5)
controls.training: cross-entropy 1.0 + supervised contrastive 0.5 + triplet margin 0.25; domain-aware positives, hard negatives, domain-balanced batches
controls.primary_score_rationale: The earlier development-only rejection study selected calibrated maximum probability in all five outer folds.

controls.architecture: channels 8/16, z64 diagonal Gaussian, cyclical_4 beta=1, spectral-composite reconstruction
controls.prediction: balanced standardized logistic probe on posterior mean
controls.primary_score_rationale: Reconstruction error is the native prespecified unsupervised novelty mechanism; all other scores remain reported.

controls.architecture: z48 chemical + z16 nuisance, beta=0.25, dependence weight 0.001, no semantic supervision/adversary/pair loss
controls.prediction: balanced standardized logistic probe on the named posterior-mean head
controls.primary_score_rationale: The mechanistic claim concerns whether the named chemical partition places unseen chemistry outside known chemical latent support; reconstruction is shared by both partitions and is secondary.

interpretation_limits.reason: These are frozen historical comparators. Their native primary score is fixed before their true-held-chemical outcomes; every applicable alternative is retained descriptively.
interpretation_limits.structured_vae_role: negative mechanistic comparator, not a rescue attempt
